content.comment_body: Dear support team, we have several versions of [product_name] PLC that we want to back up. We purchased the [product_name] USB PC cable and would like to know if [product_name] software [version_no] can be used to back up older PLC models. Please see below for our PLC order numbers: 1) Order No. [article_no] 2) Order No. [article_no] 3) Order No. [article_no]

[product_name] software [version_no] supports all [product_name] series ([article_no] range). The software is compatible regardless of the PLC's voltage class (e.g., 12/24VDC, 24DC, 24VAC/DC, or 230VAC). If you are using a USB/RS232 cable (not a pure RS232), ensure the correct USB drivers are installed.
Hi, please see the attached image of the USB cable we purchased from [company_name]. I hope this is the correct cable you are referring to.

Yes, this is the correct cable—an original [company_name] USB/RS232 cable. When installing [product_name] [version_no], be sure to install the USB driver. Also, run the setup as an administrator during installation of both software and drivers.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking for confirmation that the latest [product_name] software is compatible with older [product_name] PLC hardware for backup purposes. There is uncertainty about whether the latest version can communicate with various older devices, and some concern about driver installation for the USB/RS232 cable from [company_name]. Official guidance on hardware and software compatibility is valued.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that the most recent [product_name] software will enable backup for older hardware models and function smoothly with the [company_name] USB/RS232 cable. They also seek clear instructions for successful installation.
